caliber.universe: equity + commodity + convertible only (the capacity face's own score_row class filter, so the 5 names are the same 5 names)
relation_to_published_faces: etf_equity_alpha.json no-bond arm: 15.56% / SR 1.002 / -16.0% -- this face's width 5 reproduces that caliber, which is how the reader can tell the two readings are the same book
etf_robust_pf.json N5_R20_10bp 9.13%: FULL unrepaired universe, a different caliber -- not a disagreement, a different question
etf_nobond_vt.json 11.49%: same no-bond universe WITH the 8% vol target -- this face runs naked, so it reads higher

caveats: Both roads are priced on the same engine cell (rebalance 20, cost 10bp) and the same repaired, class-filtered panel the capacity face scores on. Widths are comparable to each other; they are NOT directly comparable to the published N5_R20_10bp reading in etf_robust_pf.json, which runs the unrepaired full universe.

The shrink road assumes an equal-weight book shrank by w earns w of the return (linear in size). It ignores that a smaller ticket has the same fixed costs -- which makes shrinking look slightly BETTER than it is, so a SHRINK_IS_CHEAPER verdict is conservative.
One extra name against one shrink, on one bar. This is not a walk down the width ladder and it does not re-price the book at 7 or 8 names.
sentence: 同一笔 1,000,000 元在 2026-11-17 这一天，5 名打 1.0087% ADV（闸线 1.00%），6 名落到 0.8405%。把这笔单子塞进线内的两条路，年化代价分别是：缩仓到 991,421 元放弃 0.1330 pp/年，加宽到 6 名放弃 -1.5000 pp/年（0.1550 → 0.1700）。加宽便宜 1.6330 pp/年 —— 第 6 名确实在摊薄容量而不伤收益。但 7 名 14.6100% / 8 名 14.9500% 都低于 6 名 —— 这是第 6 名的一个局部最优，不是「越宽越好」。
